schema_mustBeEvenHexadecimal: Must be an even-length hexadecimal string (0-9, A-F)
svm_schema_mustBeHexOrDecimal: Must be a 4-digit hexadecimal or a 5-digit decimal number
cc_schema_mustBeSameLength: Both values must have the same length
prl_schema_mustBeNonEmptyArray: Must be a array with at least one element
prl_schema_mustBeValidPrcode: Each element must be a valid PR code (3-digit string)
bc_schema_delimiterMustBeOneCharacter: Must be exactly one character long
bc_schema_backupMinLength: Must be at least {minLength} characters long
bc_schema_backupMaxLength: Must be at most {maxLength} characters long
